description: This file defines the CallScript class, which implements the <script> element in the MiniLang language for the OFBiz framework. It handles executing scripts or invoking other methods based on XML element attributes.

classes.name: CallScript
classes.description: Implements the <script> element for executing scripts or method calls within the MiniLang framework.

classes.name: CallScriptFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating CallScript instances from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Removes deprecated attribute 'error-list-name' from XML element during transition.

methods.name: CallScript
methods.description: Constructor that initializes CallScript object based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the script or method call based on the initialized attributes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CallScript object.
